summary: Cluster requirements: standalone, unclustered PostgreSQL not on a controller node (no failover management); no PgBouncer transaction pooling because controller relies on pg_notify; all instances mutually reachable with stable names and low latency; primary first in the default group for upgrades; manual projects synced by hand; keep the inventory file.
questions: Can I use PgBouncer with automation controller?
Can controller nodes be in different data centers?
Can PostgreSQL be installed on a controller node in a cluster?
